title: xmlwrite

gpu_support.notes: Host file I/O; GPU-resident inputs are gathered before execution.

description: `xmlwrite(document)` serializes a lightweight XML document or element object to text; `xmlwrite(filename, document)` writes the serialized XML to a file.
behaviors: Serializes the lightweight `org.w3c.dom.Document` and `org.w3c.dom.Element` objects returned by `xmlread`, including tag names, text content, attributes, and child nodes.
Accepts XML text values and scalar structs for compatibility with simple file-emission workflows.
Escapes XML text and attribute values. This is not a full Java DOM implementation and does not perform schema validation or formatting preservation after object mutation.
